channel.title: Workload Templates on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workload Templates on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Workload Template
item.description: This section describes how to create a workload template. You can create a workload template directly, or create a template based on an existing workload. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: View Template List
item.description: This section describes how to view the application workload template list. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Application Workload Templates in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Template Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a workload template. After a workload template is created, you can edit its basic information, pod settings, storage settings, and advanced settings. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: Create a Workload from a Template
item.description: This section describes how to create a workload from a template. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Workload Templates in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Delete Workload Templates
item.description: This section describes how to delete workload templates. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Delete a Single Workload Template Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Workload Templates in the left navigation pane.
